copy.preview: Two dates you'll want to save right now.
intro:
I wanted to give you a proper heads-up before the rush starts, because you're on my VIP list and that 
actually means the world to me. 
🌎

On 25 November, VIP early access opens, and you're first in line.
It's the biggest saving I've ever offered on our wall art sets,
and for a little while it's yours alone, before anyone else gets a look in.
Then on 27 November, Black Friday opens to everyone,
but your VIP price stays the best one of all.

Nothing to do right now, 
Just pop those two dates in your calendar 
and watch your inbox. 
I promise it'll be worth it.
copy.closingText: Cannot wait to show you what we've got lined up, it's going to be a good one. Mae x
